description: Free, no key needed. Turns a question in plain words into the exact typed Bosco Labs calls that answer it: tool, input, why, and the maximum price of each step, plus what is not covered. Pass the user's question verbatim AND the entities you extracted from it (company_names, tickers, identifiers, countries, dates, law references...): the planner trusts your entities over its own parsing and puts them in the right input fields. The plan echoes them in entities_used and lists in `missing` what to pass for a better plan. Rules and examples first; only when they are unsure and you passed no entities does a small AI step extract the entities (budget-capped, marked `assisted`). Same steps, same plan_id. Run it with run_official_records_plan (paid, max_usd) or call the listed tools directly. Low confidence returns the top 3 candidate tools instead.

addresses.description: Dutch addresses as written, e.g. ["Damrak 1 Amsterdam"].
addresses.title: Addresses

amount_min.description: A minimum amount in USD or EUR, e.g. 1000000 for "over $1M".
amount_min.title: Amount Min

company_names.description: Companies, with legal form if given, e.g. ["Novo Nordisk A/S"]; also fund managers and hiring companies.
company_names.title: Company Names

countries.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (or English names), e.g. ["DE", "NL"]: the registry country, buyer country, origin of goods or trial location.
countries.title: Countries

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, start of the asked period (resolve relative dates).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, end of the asked period.
date_to.title: Date To

entities.description: The same fields as one object (either form works).
entities.title: Entities

identifiers.description: Identifiers by kind, each a list of strings: lei, isin, cik, figi, company_number, kvk, cvr, org_number, nct, cve, ecli, celex, cfr, hs_code, naics, postcode, bag_id, vat, iban, wallet, krs, nip, regon. company_number may carry its country as a prefix: "GB:00445790".
identifiers.title: Identifiers

keywords.description: The topic or search phrase in the user's words, e.g. "cloud hosting", "huurrecht", "non-small cell lung cancer".
keywords.title: Keywords

law.description: A law reference: {"act": "GDPR", "article": "6"} or {"act": "Companies Act 2006", "article": "172", "jurisdiction": "UK"}; jurisdiction EU, UK or NL.
law.title: Law

person_names.description: People, e.g. ["Nancy Pelosi"] (House members, sanctions targets).
person_names.title: Person Names

products.description: Drugs, consumer products or goods, e.g. ["Ozempic"], ["2019 Honda Accord"], ["cotton t-shirt"].
products.title: Products

question.description: The user's question, verbatim (EN, NL, DE or FR).
question.title: Question

name: plan_official_records_query
title: Plan an official-records query
